title: Sapphire16x
description: A shiny light blue pvp texturepack.
body:
Sapphire is a minecraft pvp texturepack

This pack changes the textures of pvp based items some of which are:
- Tools (Diamond Sword, Axe, Pickaxe and the netherite versions)
- Crystals
- Obsidian
- Respawn Anchor
- Ender pearls
- Particals (Crits, Slash, explosion and more)

thats not all it changes more textures but you can go see those for yourself
